cases.name: diagnose existing case no git diff
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"diagnose timeout case",fixturePath:"diagnose"}); const d = JSON.parse(r); return d.lastPassCommit === null && (d.traceSummary.includes("无历史") || d.rootCause.some(c => c.includes("环境") || c.includes("无代码")))

cases.name: diagnose timeout case
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"nonexistent-timeout"}); return JSON.parse(r).error !== undefined

cases.name: diagnose concurrent safe
cases.execute: const [r1,r2] = await Promise.all([$handlers.diagnose({caseName:"no1"}),$handlers.diagnose({caseName:"no2"})]); return r1 !== undefined && r2 !== undefined

cases.name: setup: create trace fixture
cases.execute: const ts = await import("file:///"+$root.split("\\").join("/")+"/packages/main/dist/tasks/trace-store.js"); const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; ts.saveTraceSnapshot(dir,"diagnose","diagnose existing case no git diff",[{fn:"testFn",file:"test.ts",line:1,children:[]}],$root); return true

cases.name: diagnose full pipeline
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"diagnose existing case no git diff",fixturePath:"diagnose"}); const d = JSON.parse(r); return d.caseName==="diagnose existing case no git diff" && d.lastPassCommit && Array.isArray(d.rootCause) && typeof d.suggestion==="string"

cases.name: diagnose rootCause cross ref
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"diagnose existing case no git diff",fixturePath:"diagnose"}); const d = JSON.parse(r); return d.traceSummary !== undefined && d.suggestion !== undefined

cases.name: diagnose no lastPass snapshot
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"setup: create test story",fixturePath:"checklist-add"}); const d = JSON.parse(r); return d.lastPassCommit === null && d.traceSummary.includes("无历史")

cases.name: diagnose case pass no action
cases.execute: const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"diagnose existing case no git diff",fixturePath:"diagnose"}); const d = JSON.parse(r); return typeof d.suggestion === "string" && d.suggestion.length > 0 && d.rootCause.length >= 0 && d.caseName === "diagnose existing case no git diff"

cases.name: diagnose corrupt lastPass
cases.execute: const fs = await import("fs"); const dir = $root+"/packages/main/tests/fixtures"; fs.writeFileSync(dir+"/diagnose.trace.json","corrupt"); const r = await $handlers.diagnose({caseName:"diagnose existing case no git diff",fixturePath:"diagnose"}); const d = JSON.parse(r); return d.lastPassCommit === null;
